title: refmeta core record
description: One refmeta record: what one source says about a reference genome, split into levels. Each level has its own identifier: assembly (accession), collection (seqcol digest), sequence (refget digest or md5), copy (location plus file checksum), deployment (system plus key). Every block is optional; a record fills only what its source knows. See mapping/PROPOSAL.md.

subject.description: Which level the source record is mainly about. Used to choose a primary identifier and when writing back out.

sequences.description: Sequences. In a record about a collection, this is the collection in order, and sequences[].name is the name the collection uses. In a record about an assembly, it lists the assembly's sequences, and their names live only in aliases.

copies.description: Files: a FASTA, an index, a chrom.sizes file, a 2bit file, and so on. Identified by location plus checksum.

deployments.description: Entries in a system that uses the genome: a Galaxy data table row, a refgenie asset, an nf-core --genome key, a Bioconductor package, a UCSC browser database.

provenance.description: Where the facts in this record came from. A record made from one file has one entry. A merged record has several.

fieldSources.description: Optional map from a core path (as used in crosswalks, e.g. 'assembly.level') to the provenance ids that gave the value. Omitted when every value has the same provenance.

conflicts.description: Values that disagreed when native rows or records were combined. The core keeps the first value; the others are listed here.

Extras.description: Native fields with no core home, kept so that writing back to the same format loses nothing. Keyed by format id, then by native field path exactly as in fields.json.

Name.description: A name in a namespace. Whether a name may point to more than one thing depends on the list it is in (aliases: no; labels: yes). Official namespaces are listed in mapping/namespaces.yaml; other lower-case ids are allowed as custom namespaces.

namespace.description: Lower-case namespace id: an official one from mapping/namespaces.yaml (insdc, refseq, ucsc, galaxy.dbkey, ...) or a custom one.

scope.description: Where the name is valid when the namespace is not global: a server URL, a pipeline name, a registry. Omitted for global namespaces.

Accession.description: An assembly accession: a Name in an accession namespace (insdc.gca, insdc.gcf, or a custom one), plus the link a source gave for it.

namespace.description: Lower-case namespace id: insdc.gca, insdc.gcf (mapping/namespaces.yaml), or a custom one.

url.description: A web page for this accession, as the source gave it (FHR accessionID.url).

id.description: NCBI Taxonomy id as given by the source (may be strain level, e.g. 559292). FHR writes it as taxon.uri https://identifiers.org/taxonomy:<id>.

name.description: Scientific name (FHR taxon.name). Sources disagree on whether the strain is included.

commonName.description: Common name of the species (human, baker's yeast).

speciesId.description: NCBI Taxonomy id at species rank (e.g. 4932 for S. cerevisiae when id is 559292).

strain.description: Strain, isolate, breed or cultivar label (e.g. S288C, CHM13).

name.description: Name of the person or organization.

uri.description: Link that identifies the author, such as an ORCID or ROR URL.

nameType.description: Whether the author is a person or an organization.

commandLineOption.description: Command-line options the program was run with.

VitalStats.description: FHR vitalStats, plus ungappedLength and coverage (refmeta additions). Sources define 'total length' differently; see the crosswalk lossy notes.

numberChromosomes.description: refmeta addition: chromosomes plus organelles and plasmids (NCBI total_number_of_chromosomes, ENA replicon-count).

coverage.description: refmeta addition: sequencing depth as the source writes it (30.0x, 83).

Assembly.description: The assembly level: an assembled genome as an archive registers it. Field names follow FHR where FHR covers the fact; accessions (FHR accessionID) and taxon.id (FHR taxon.uri) are the two deliberate changes.

accessions.description: Identifiers that archives issued for this assembly version, such as a GenBank and RefSeq pair (GCA_000001405.15 and GCF_000001405.26). The identifier of this level. The first item is the accession the source record is about; formats with one accession slot write the first item. Namespaces: mapping/namespaces.yaml.

name.description: Submitter's assembly name (GRCh38, GRCh38.p14, R64). Not unique: the same name spans versions and the GCA/GCF pair.

version.description: FHR version: the genome's own version. refgenie writes the accession's version number here ('15').

level.description: Assembly level, lower case: complete genome, chromosome, scaffold, contig.

type.description: NCBI assembly type: haploid, haploid-with-alt-loci, diploid, alternate-pseudohaplotype, unresolved-diploid.

releaseDate.description: When the archive released this version (ISO 8601, may be partial).

biosample.description: BioSample accession of the sequenced sample.

assemblyAuthor.description: People or organizations who made the assembly (FHR assemblyAuthor).

voucherSpecimen.description: Where a physical specimen of the sequenced organism is kept (FHR voucherSpecimen).

reuseConditions.description: License or reuse terms (FHR reuseConditions; gtars 'license').

assemblySoftware.description: Programs used to build the assembly (FHR assemblySoftware).

assemblyProtocol.description: How the assembly was made, as text or a link (FHR assemblyProtocol).

documentation.description: FHR documentation: free text about the genome.

identifier.description: FHR identifier: related identifiers as prefix:accession strings (bioproject:PRJNA31257). Kept as written.

relatedLink.description: Other web pages about the assembly (FHR relatedLink).

labels.description: Names that may cover more than this assembly version (assembly names, UCSC names given as NCBI synonyms, Ensembl coordinate system versions).

Level1.description: Seqcol level 1: the digest of each attribute array. Keys are the seqcol attribute names.

Relation.description: How this collection relates to another one. Computed with seqcol comparison, or asserted by a source.

digest.description: Seqcol digest of the other collection.

Collection.description: The sequence collection level: one exact list of named sequences. Identified by its GA4GH seqcol digest.

digest.description: Seqcol top-level (level 0) digest, 32 base64url characters, no prefix.

nSequences.description: Number of sequences in the collection.

totalLength.description: Sum of the lengths of the collection's sequences, in bases.

provider.description: Who distributed this sequence set (UCSC, Ensembl, NCBI, GENCODE, iGenomes). Case as written by the source.

providerVersion.description: The provider's release label for this set (Ensembl 115, GENCODE 49).

namingAuthority.description: The sequence-name namespace the collection's names follow (ucsc, ensembl, insdc, refseq, assembly).

relationToAssembly.description: How the set relates to the assembly's own sequences: complete (all top-level sequences), primary (primary assembly unit only), subset, superset (adds decoys, viral or other sequences), derived (changed, e.g. hard-masked or mixed), unknown.

aliases.description: Names that point to exactly one collection within their namespace and scope (refgenie aliases, Galaxy unique_build_id, legacy refgenie digests, iGenomes paths).

labels.description: Names that may cover several collections (UCSC hg38, Galaxy dbkey, FHR genome, nf-core --genome keys, Bioconductor genome()).

Placement.description: Where an alternate locus, patch or unlocalized scaffold sits.

chromosome.description: Chromosome name, in the source's naming.

length.description: Length of the sequence, in bases.

digest.description: GA4GH refget identifier: 'SQ.' + sha512t24u of the uppercased sequence.

md5.description: MD5 of the uppercased sequence (refget md5, SAM M5), 32 lowercase hex.

aliases.description: The sequence-name map: this sequence's names in other naming styles (insdc CM000663.2, refseq NC_000001.11, ucsc chr1, ensembl 1, assembly 1).

role.description: NCBI Sequence-Role spelling: assembled-molecule, unlocalized-scaffold, unplaced-scaffold, alt-scaffold, fix-patch, novel-patch.

molecule.description: Assigned molecule type: Chromosome, Mitochondrion, Chloroplast, Plasmid, ...

assignedMolecule.description: Chromosome the sequence belongs to (1, X, MT).

circular.description: True if the molecule is circular (a mitochondrion, a plasmid, most bacterial chromosomes).

description.description: Free-text description of the sequence, such as the text after the name in a FASTA header.

gcPercent.description: Percent of G and C bases in the sequence.

Checksums.description: Checksums keyed by algorithm: md5, sha1, sha256, sha512, crc32 (hex); fhr (FHR SHA-512/256 base64 over the file without its checksum line); refgenie_asset and refgenie_archive (legacy refgenie digests).

location.description: URL, s3:// URI or file path, as the source writes it (may be relative or hold placeholders such as ${params.igenomes_base}).

kind.description: What the file is: fasta, fai, dict, 2bit, chrom_sizes, chrom_alias, len, genome_size_xml, bwa_index, bwamem2_index, bowtie_index, bowtie2_index, star_index, hisat2_index, bismark_index, salmon_index, kallisto_index, rsem_index, dragmap_index, gtf, gff, refgenie_asset, other.

uncompressedSize.description: Size of the file after decompression, in bytes.

masking.description: FHR masking: soft-masked, hard-masked, not-masked, unknown.

toolVersion.description: For index files: the version of the tool that built or can read the index.

system.description: galaxy, refgenie, nfcore, igenomes, ucsc, ensembl, bioconductor, annotationhub, refget_store.

scope.description: Which instance: server URL, pipeline name, release.

table.description: Galaxy data table, refgenie asset name, or similar slot.

key.description: The identifier the system uses for this entry (Galaxy value, nf-core genome key, package name).

displayName.description: Name the system shows to users for this entry (Galaxy's name column).

location.description: File or directory the entry points to (same string as the matching copies[].location).

id.description: Short id used by fieldSources and conflicts (p1, p2, ...).

authority.description: Who asserts the facts (NCBI, a Galaxy server admin, a refgenie registry contributor).

url.description: Where the native record was fetched.

file.description: Local file name, when there is no URL.

authors.description: Who wrote the source record (FHR metadataAuthor, a registry contributor). Crosswalk rules may fill provenance[0].authors.

recordDate.description: When the source record was created or last updated, as the record itself says (ISO 8601, may be partial). Crosswalk rules may fill provenance[0].recordDate.
